name: Unknown
source:
A mysterious boy whose name is unknown. He knows all about Yukina, Youji and Kouichi, and speaks in riddles.  He's a bit of a tease and likes ribbing Yukina. His true purpose is still unknown.

[spoiler]His name is Rei.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://www.roseverte.net/duplicity/echaracter.html]the official website in English[/url]]
